settings_menu.err_version_required.en: This change must say which version of the side menu it replaces. Read the side menu first and send its ETag in an If-Match header.

settings_menu.err_changed.en: The side menu changed after you read it, so this change was not saved. Read it again and make the change on the current version.

settings_menu.changed_elsewhere.en: Someone else changed the side menu while you were saving, so your change was not saved. The list below shows the menu as it is now. Make your change again.
